title: Diagnose local GMGN signed CLI configuration without a provider request
objective: Perform a local-only, no-network diagnostic after the bounded signed GMGN holdings pilot returned `gmgn_request_unavailable`. Confirm only the presence (never values) of required GMGN environment variables, inspect the locally installed gmgn-cli version and its credential-variable contract as pinned by the tracked package manifests, and document whether the observed environment names meet that local contract. Do not invoke any GMGN command that makes a request, and do not infer the validity of a credential from presence alone. Retain only safe configuration facts and stable diagnostic codes.
forbidden_actions: Do not call GMGN, Helius, Dune, Chain.fm or any network provider.
Do not print, persist, commit or quote API keys, private keys, credential-bearing URLs, raw provider payloads, arbitrary provider text or full exception text.
Do not change environment variables, credentials, package manifests, dependency versions, application code, tests or configuration.
Do not write outside the exact tracked write set.
